grade.label: exactly one gh call: the full-field issue read, and no tracker write
the call counter is live — claiming zero issue reads fails (negative)
the analysis passes the Validate-analysis-data rules (git_state, updatedAt verbatim, option numbering, decision record)
gi-ready.py --coverage finds every criterion covered by the recommended option
.idd/analysis-42.json was replaced atomically and re-read equal
read-only: no tracked file changed and nothing was written outside .idd/
a renamed commit_sha, a re-derived updatedAt, a missing recommended option or an unknown criterion id is refused (negative)
the recommended option leaves no criterion uncovered (negative)

criteria: report.txt leads with DONE and the root cause, with its path:line, before any detail.
The root cause is labeled as observed in code, not as a reproduced failure.
The recommended option names the criteria it covers, and the report says no approval is needed.
human_review.feedback: Record each reviewer answer; absent, blank, or nonresponsive feedback leaves understanding unconfirmed.
human_review.scope: This deterministic stand-in runs the real gi-issue.py and gi-ready.py on a recorded issue; whether a live agent finds the root cause or ranks options well is out of its scope.
